description_en: Queries the configurations of web tamper proofing for a specified server
description_zh: 查询指定服务器的网页防篡改防护配置
name: DescribeWebLockConfigList

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the request
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server.

You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to query the UUID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询防护配置的服务器的UUID。
您可以调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID of the protected directory
parameters.name: id

ConfigList.description_en: The configurations of web tamper proofing
ConfigList.description_zh: 网页防篡改防护配置列表信息

items.description_en: The configuration of web tamper proofing
items.description_zh: 网页防篡改防护配置信息

DefenceMode.description_en:
The prevention mode. Valid values:

block: Interception Mode
audit: Alert Mode
DefenceMode.description_zh:
防护模式。取值：

block：拦截
audit：告警

Dir.description_en: The directory that has web tamper proofing enabled

ExclusiveDir.description_en:
The directory that has web tamper proofing disabled.

If the value of Mode is blacklist, this parameter is returned
ExclusiveDir.description_zh:
防篡改保护排除的目录。
防护模式Mode为blacklist时，会返回该参数

ExclusiveFile.description_en:
The file that has web tamper proofing disabled.

If the value of Mode is blacklist, this parameter is returned
ExclusiveFile.description_zh:
防篡改保护排除的文件。
防护模式Mode为blacklist时，会返回该参数

ExclusiveFileType.description_en:
The type of the file that has web tamper proofing disabled.

If the value of Mode is blacklist, this parameter is returned
ExclusiveFileType.description_zh:
防篡改保护排除文件的类型。
防护模式Mode为blacklist时，会返回该参数

Id.description_en: The configuration ID of the protected directory

InclusiveFile.description_en:
The file that has web tamper proofing enabled.

If the value of Mode is whitelist, this parameter is returned
InclusiveFile.description_zh:
防篡改防护的文件。
防护模式Mode为whitelist时，会返回该参数

InclusiveFileType.description_en:
The type of the file that has web tamper proofing enabled.

If the value of Mode is whitelist, this parameter is returned
InclusiveFileType.description_zh:
防篡改要防护的文件类型。
防护模式Mode为whitelist时，会返回该参数

LocalBackupDir.description_en: The local path to the backup files of the protected directory
LocalBackupDir.description_zh: 本地备份路径，用于对防护目录进行安全备份

Mode.description_en:
The protection mode of web tamper proofing. Valid values:

whitelist: In this mode, web tamper proofing is enabled for the specified directories and file types.
blacklist: In this mode, web tamper proofing is enabled for the unspecified subdirectories, file types, and files in the protected directory
Mode.description_zh:
网页防篡改的防护模式。取值：
whitelist：白名单模式，会对添加的防护目录和文件类型进行保护。
blacklist：黑名单模式，会对添加的防护目录下所有未排除的子目录、文件类型和指定文件进行保护

Uuid.description_en: The UUID of the server that has web tamper proofing enabled
Uuid.description_zh: 防篡改防护的服务器的UUID

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of directories that have web tamper proofing enabled on the server
TotalCount.description_zh: 该服务器已配置网页防篡改防护目录的总数
